description.fun: Turtonator is a living landmine of a turtle: it eats sulfur and other volcanic stuff, which leaves an explosive layer in its shell (and makes its droppings explosive too). When prey steps on its back, it whacks its shell with its tail, and sparks from the spikes set off a blast that shoots out of the hole in its belly, which is also its weak spot. Rain dampens its explosions, so on wet days it hides in caves.
description.guide: Turtonator is a Fire- and Dragon-type turtle Pokémon from Alola that lives on volcanoes. Its shell contains explosive material that goes off when struck, and it is the only Pokémon that learns Shell Trap. It is a version-exclusive counterpart to Drampa.
description.tagline: A volcano turtle with an explosive shell, and explosive droppings
